TR-1-C01.scenario: Define itemized Ahri independently of Invoker. Distinguish no active Invoker, active Invoker without an emblem on Ahri, and Invoker Emblem actually held by Ahri; preserve named star/build and level strata.
TR-1-C01.plan: Resolve Ahri, Invoker and its emblem. compare_cohorts active Invoker versus its complement within the Ahri investment shell covers missing trait rows. Query explicit active/no-holder-emblem and holder-emblem cells, and inspect counts/traits/loadouts within recurring named cores. Other-holder emblems are a separate inventory category.
TR-1-C01.checks: Report group sizes/shares and mean/top4/win without selecting only 'Invoker Ahri' as the whole family. Preserve the distinction between an emblem on Ahri and native allied activation. Compare common mana/item/support contexts and acknowledge sparse overlap.
TR-1-C01.limits: No nested negative trait condition matches absence of a row; active:false alone omits it. Global no-emblem boards are a stronger claim than no emblem on Ahri. Invoker and emblem effect values need a patch-compatible reference beyond the older local baseline.

TR-1-C02.scenario: Itemized Soraka family, independently selected, with recorded three versus four Executioner contributors crossed with Kennen absent versus present: four cells.
TR-1-C02.plan: Use explicit Executioner contributing-unit bounds, verify active state and relevant breakpoint rules, and add Kennen named presence/absence in each cohort. compare_cohorts compares three versus four inside each Kennen stratum and Kennen association inside each contribution stratum. Query actual displaced/support units and item investment.
TR-1-C02.checks: All four cells need counts and outcomes or an explicit lack of support; one frequent Kennen row is insufficient. Report within-stratum mean/top4/win differences and distinguish contribution count from medal tier or a causal source of improvement.
TR-1-C02.limits: No automatic interaction significance test or matching on global budget. Lux/Kha'Zix choice must not be reconstructed from roster arithmetic; use recorded traits and mark ambiguous source quality.

TR-1-C03.scenario: Cassiopeia as an itemized carry, with two/four/six Defender contribution strata. The historical before/after claim requires separate verified pre-18.3 and post-18.3 data with compatible collection provenance.
TR-1-C03.plan: In the current selected scope, discover exact Cassiopeia builds and compare Defender strata inside named core/star/level conditions. A second independently pinned run can produce the other window's same strata, but compare_cohorts cannot read two databases or arbitrary time windows in one call. Keep temporal synthesis outside this single-scope item unless validated aggregate evidence is supplied in input.
TR-1-C03.checks: Answer current package performance with cell counts/mean/top4/win and prevalence. Only claim a change after buffs when both windows' evidence is actually available; compare within-tier shifts and six-versus-lower gaps without attributing causality to simultaneous buffs. Missing pre-period data is not a zero change.
TR-1-C03.limits: A standard native dataset item selects one database; arbitrary metadata cannot provide an executable second data source. No automatic patch/time filter, difference-in-differences evaluator or guaranteed hotfix boundary. The single-scope runnable adaptation explicitly limits the temporal claim.
TR-1-C03.adaptation: Retain the original player question, adding in dataset input that this run uses the selected scope and can answer current two/four/six-Defender performance; a before/after conclusion needs supplied pre-period evidence. The temporal requirement is tracked as a preparation gap rather than fabricated or silently dropped.

TR-2-C01.scenario: Constructed eight-unit anchors share Ornn, Alistar, Hecarim, Ezreal, Gnar and Kennen; Shen/Taric versus Xayah/LeBlanc. Ezreal2 carries three named ordinary items; inspect recorded five/seven Elderwood contribution states.
TR-2-C01.plan: Resolve named units/traits/items and compare contains-core plus each mutually exclusive pair, sharing exact Ezreal build and declared tank stars/items. Use direct Elderwood trait conditions to verify activation and query board_size/other units for possible extra members; examine total named Elderwood upgrade vectors. For the fully enumerated 8-identity roster, query_cohort grouped by board_size can expose a reportable row equal to 8; that row establishes no extra or duplicate stored identities and supplies its own sample/outcomes. Keep these exact-record results separate from broader compare_cohorts summaries and intervals.
TR-2-C01.checks: Keep exact anchor comparison separate from broad five/seven Elderwood cohorts. Report support, mean/top4/win and uncertainty with changed frontline packages; do not infer the plant's causal combat value or make a tooltip answer substitute for outcomes.
TR-2-C01.limits: No direct exact-roster filter exists, but the eight-required-identities/eight-record grouped row certifies stored-roster closure and any fully specified named star vector. It does not certify occupied capacity or global emblem exclusion. Broader comparison summaries do not inherit this row restriction.

TR-2-C02.scenario: Constructed interpretation: Ornn, Alistar, Hecarim, Ezreal, Gnar, Alune and Taric plus Kennen1 versus confirmed Inferno Lux1; Ezreal2 has the same named three-item build. Support two-star variants separate.
TR-2-C02.plan: Disclose the missing-player-roster assumption in input. Resolve actual observable Lux variant identity and verify Inferno/Executioner records; compare supported named package predicates and frontline investments. Inspect existing named burn equipment as an explicit sensitivity, not assumed coverage. For the fully enumerated 8-identity roster, query_cohort grouped by board_size can expose a reportable row equal to 8; that row establishes no extra or duplicate stored identities and supplies its own sample/outcomes. Keep these exact-record results separate from broader compare_cohorts summaries and intervals.
TR-2-C02.checks: Preserve one-star support asymmetry and named roster anchor. A generic Lux resolution plus board Inferno does not prove Inferno Lux; if that identity cannot be certified, report the package proxy and leave the form-specific claim unproven. Counts/outcomes must belong to the actual constrained packages.
TR-2-C02.limits: The eight-required-identities/eight-record row can certify stored-roster closure, not occupied capacity. No unique Lux-form field or burn-uptime field exists; local reference explains variants but does not guarantee ingestion preserves them.

TR-2-C03.scenario: Akali3, Camille3, Varus3, Leona3, Ornn3 and Taric1 shared; Kayle2/Sejuani2 versus Solar Lux1/Maokai1. Akali/Camille each have declared matched three-item builds; swapped supports have zero completed items.
TR-2-C03.plan: Use explicit named upgrade vectors and unique-holder item counts, compare mutually exclusive support pairs, and inspect recorded Solar/Eclipse traits and exact Lux identity. Query board_size and other equipment for unmodeled extras. No global count shortcut replaces the five exact three-star requirements. For the fully enumerated 8-identity roster, query_cohort grouped by board_size can expose a reportable row equal to 8; that row establishes no extra or duplicate stored identities and supplies its own sample/outcomes. Keep these exact-record results separate from broader compare_cohorts summaries and intervals.
TR-2-C03.checks: Report these very specific cohort samples before any broadening. Preserve itemless swapped supports and asymmetrical stars. Distinguish a sparse or unresolvable exact case from a generic Solar-versus-Adaptor result; do not assert richer-board confounding has been eliminated.
TR-2-C03.limits: The eight-required-identities/eight-record row can certify stored-roster closure and specified stars, but broader cohorts cannot assume it. Global emblem exclusion and generic missing-Eclipse conjunction remain separate limitations. Lux identity, Maokai permanent health and Ornn history remain unobserved or unresolved.

TR-2-C04.scenario: Shared Alune1, Aphelios2, Diana2, Amumu2, Shen2, Kennen1 and Gnar2; Solar Lux1/Sejuani2 versus Taric1/Maokai1, swapped units unitemized and Aphelios exact three-item carry build. Original intent: nine-unit, no-three-star, no-emblem end states.
TR-2-C04.plan: Compare named contains-core packages with exact listed stars and zero-item support conditions, verifying Eclipse through actual trait activation. Query board_size and investment diagnostics; distinguish named-unit no-three-star enforcement from an unverified global prohibition. For the fully enumerated 9-identity roster, query_cohort grouped by board_size can expose a reportable row equal to 9; that row establishes no extra or duplicate stored identities and supplies its own sample/outcomes. Keep these exact-record results separate from broader compare_cohorts summaries and intervals.
TR-2-C04.checks: Keep both support pairs, asymmetric costs/stars and fixed carry investment. Report joint counts/outcomes and available uncertainty, not pooled Eclipse averages. State whether exact nine-record/no-extra-upgrade eligibility was actually certified.
TR-2-C04.limits: No board_size filter exists. A reportable nine-required-identities/nine-record row certifies the named roster and, with every exact star constrained, no extra three-star unit; use that row’s outcomes. Broader contains-core results do not establish these restrictions. Global emblem exclusion and exact occupied capacity remain separate gaps. Solar Lux cannot be inferred from a generic match.

TR-2-C05.scenario: Shared Shen2, Amumu2, Kennen2, Inferno Lux2, Alune1, Ezreal2 and Gnar2; Akali2/Varus2 versus Taric1/Maokai1, swapped units itemless. Lux three AP items, Amumu three tank items, Kennen only Protector's Vow; seven versus five Inferno intended.

Compare the two named support packages, inspect unit-count and remaining-item distributions, and resolve Lux's observable identity before form-specific statements. For the fully enumerated 9-identity roster, query_cohort grouped by board_size can expose a reportable row equal to 9; that row establishes no extra or duplicate stored identities and supplies its own sample/outcomes. Keep these exact-record results separate from broader compare_cohorts summaries and intervals.
TR-2-C05.checks: Preserve support item counts and all fixed primary investments; do not replace the two-star dropped units with weaker ones. Report samples and mean/top4/win and explain changed final packages rather than historical generated shop value.
TR-2-C05.limits: A reportable nine-required-identities/nine-record row certifies stored-roster closure and the specified stars, but not occupied capacity or uninspected emblem inventory. Broader comparisons lack that closure. No shop value, transition route or earlier Inferno economy is observed; generic Lux may only support a heterogeneous proxy.

TR-2-C06.scenario: Shared Tristana3, Rammus2, Kobuko2, Veigar2, Gnar2, Sett2 with Fae Emblem and two tank items. Rakan2/Xayah2 versus Fae Lux1/Taric1, all swapped supports itemless; repeat Rakan3/Xayah3 retention separately.
TR-2-C06.plan: Bind emblem to the single Sett copy, fix declared Tristana carry and Sett tank builds, verify recorded four-Fae activation and actual Lux variant, then compare both retention upgrade strata against the compressed-support package. Query extra-unit and item-budget diagnostics. For the fully enumerated 8-identity roster, query_cohort grouped by board_size can expose a reportable row equal to 8; that row establishes no extra or duplicate stored identities and supplies its own sample/outcomes. Keep these exact-record results separate from broader compare_cohorts summaries and intervals.
TR-2-C06.checks: Three support states must be explicit: two-star retention, three-star retention and Lux1/Taric1. Report counts/outcomes and actual Fae record, preserving the emblem's equipment slot rather than counting three additional tank items.
TR-2-C06.limits: A reportable eight-required-identities/eight-record row certifies stored-roster closure and the specified stars, but not occupied capacity or global item matching. Pixie stacks, duration and Lux variant from generic identity cannot be inferred.

TR-3-C01.scenario: Cassiopeia carry with Fiddlesticks and six-Defender support, comparing Defender Emblem on Rengar versus Kha'Zix with explicit holder stars and remaining two item slots.
TR-3-C01.plan: Use exact holder-bound emblem predicates, named one-copy holder guards and carry/frontline investment in compare_cohorts. Discover actual supporting cores and verify Defender contribution counts; inspect alternate cores rather than treating six Defender as a roster.
TR-3-C01.checks: Sample sizes and mean/top4/win must come from the joint emblem-holder/core cells. Preserve holder upgrades and remaining items, report support-slot changes and both-holder overlap if present. An emblem-wide ranking is insufficient.
TR-3-C01.limits: Exactly one Defender emblem can be counted by its exact item name; zero other emblem families/global upgraded-board cost cannot be assumed. Rival choices and unseen trait grants are not recoverable from generic unit names.

TR-3-C02.scenario: Hunter Emblem on Camille with Caitlyn versus Hunter Emblem on Nidalee with Sivir. Vanguard/Coven leads are discovered support conditions, not assumed complete optimal rosters.
TR-3-C02.plan: Build actual emblem-holder/carry partner cohorts, inspect stars/loadouts and recurring support, verify Hunter contribution intervals, and compare reportable packages at shared final levels/named investment. Keep low-cost three-star versus four-cost two-star versions distinct.
TR-3-C02.checks: Explain exact support and equipment-slot cost of each package with counts/outcomes. Bind emblems to intended holders; neither item-wide Hunter stats nor independent Camille/Caitlyn marginals answer the joint comparison.
TR-3-C02.limits: No generic upgraded-board-cost or equivalent-economic-investment predicate. Old 18.2 external snapshots provide no current gold and must not be pooled into the selected scope.

TR-3-C04.scenario: Master Yi carrying Brawler Emblem, ordinary Edge of Night/Guinsoo's as the primary ordinary complement, compared with named artifact complements in the same discovered family.
TR-3-C04.plan: Discover exact emblem-bearing loadouts and observed Yi/Rengar/Vi/Nidalee or alternate support cores without conflating them. Compare named ordinary and artifact holder trios in shared star/trait/level contexts, and query other equipped items to assess whole-board special dependence.
TR-3-C04.checks: Separate ordinary Yi items from artifact-free entire boards. Report counts/top4/win and complete package identity, including actual teammates and upgrades; do not use a broad guide-family headline as the exact emblem/star/trio sample.
TR-3-C04.limits: Global artifact-free eligibility and artifact-count matching are unavailable as direct filters. The strict reputation question needs that prepared partition; current evidence can still compare declared holder packages honestly.

TR-3-C05.scenario: Kha'Zix carry plus Fiddlesticks in five-Inferno end states. One arm retains Akali and a third ordinary Kha'Zix item; the other binds Inferno Emblem to Kha'Zix, excludes Akali and uses an actually observed replacement support.
TR-3-C05.plan: Discover replacement candidates under emblem+Akali-absence conditions, verify candidate conjunctions, then compare each named final package with shared Kha'Zix co-items/stars and tank investment. Verify recorded five-Inferno support and query board_size/level diagnostics.
TR-3-C05.checks: Account for both the consumed item slot and the altered support unit. State the chosen replacement and actual counts/outcomes; Soraka/Maokai are leads, not automatically optimal. Exact no-extra-slot claims need certification.
TR-3-C05.limits: No general exact-board-size filter, evolution choice or farm-history data. Package association cannot identify the causal value of the emblem alone.

TR-4-C01.scenario: Exactly six recorded Juggernaut contributors in the primary slice; inspect Hunter/Primal, Summoner and overlapping support packages with declared itemized carry roles.
TR-4-C01.plan: Use the named Juggernaut contribution condition, discover actual carry pairs and support, then verify both joint package traits and unit conjunctions. compare_cohorts compares explicit package cells, keeping intersections separate and stratifying named carry/tank stars and loadouts.
TR-4-C01.checks: Report counts, recurrence and mean/top4/win for each package, not a single six-Juggernaut marginal. Preserve AP/AD item differences, named Gunblade holders and Maokai presence rather than assuming equal equipment from the trait count.
TR-4-C01.limits: Exactly six contributors is a deliberately narrower definition than all boards in a six-activation breakpoint band; report a broader band separately if used. Generic role, total-board budget and automatic family discovery remain unsupported.

TR-4-C02.scenario: Itemized Kayle/Solar and itemized Aphelios/Lunar families defined independently of Eclipse; dual-itemized boards separate, with explicit Solar-member upgrade vectors.
TR-4-C02.plan: Within each family/star vector, compare active Eclipse against its complement in the shared shell, so missing trait rows are included in the without-active group. Query recorded Solar/Lunar support and verify named three-star contributors. Contrast the resulting within-family estimates descriptively.
TR-4-C02.checks: Report all family-by-Eclipse cells with upgrade definitions, samples and outcomes before claiming an interaction. Do not use a single pooled Eclipse average or silently assign dual-carry boards to both independent groups.
TR-4-C02.limits: No global unique-three-star-count filter or native interaction confidence interval. Named upgrade vectors are supported; exhaustive upgrade-depth strata and Lux choice require preparation/observable identity.

TR-4-C03.scenario: Mama Beak has at least two explicitly offensive completed items, three-item sensitivity, exact stars retained; compare three Summoner/three Riftbeast with higher Riftbeast support, preserving hybrids.
TR-4-C03.plan: Discover named offensive loadouts to operationalize carry investment, then define joint Summoner/Riftbeast contribution cohorts rather than mutually exclusive guide labels. Compare packages in shared stars/levels/named frontline and secondary-carry conditions; inspect deployed-unit and item-count distributions.
TR-4-C03.checks: Show qualifying item builds, cell counts and mean/top4/win; distinguish unitemized Mama Beak from the carry population. Keep hybrid higher-Riftbeast+Summoner groups explicit. This tests support packages, not Titan's versus Kraken.
TR-4-C03.limits: No generic offensive-item predicate, exact-board-size matching or Alpha Mark ownership. Exact role taxonomy is a declared candidate-build choice, not combat damage evidence.

TR-4-C04.scenario: Azir and Zyra each hold at least two declared offensive completed items, stars separated; Blackthorn/Brawler versus Juggernaut/extra-Executioner supporting packages, with hybrids retained.
TR-4-C04.plan: Use exact named item/loadout evidence to establish both carry proxies, discover supporting unit conjunctions and recorded trait contributions, and compare explicit packages at shared level/star/investment conditions. Inspect Summoner support and extra carry/tank items through grouped cohort tables.
TR-4-C04.checks: Both carries must be itemized in the queried population. Report package recurrence, counts and placement/top4/win with overlap and actual supporting-unit changes. Do not treat coexisting Blackthorn/Juggernaut/Executioner traits as exclusive without checking.
TR-4-C04.limits: No offensive-role field, total-board budget filter, sacrifice identity, summon contribution or tanking output. Observed support-package association is the benchmark, not a causal explanation of Blackthorn benefits.
